history.administration_response: The Administration stated that, as part of the process for the preparation of the statement on internal control for 2022, cross-sectoral consultative workshops, including with peacekeeping operations, are planned in the latter part of 2022 and early 2023. Key controls reflected in the 2021 risk control matrices are currently under review with the objective of simplifying the framework and reducing the number of controls. In conjunction, the process control module of the SAP governance risk and compliance software is being developed, and the plan is to pilot it in a qualified joint venture in 2022, also with the objective of making the exercise agile for participating entities.
